use_when.statement: Card layout. Stacks header, body and footer down the card — the default arrangement used across Lumo screens.
use_when.verbatim: Card layout. Stacks header, body and footer down the card — the default arrangement used across Lumo screens.

dont_use_when.verbatim: Don’t use it when the card leads with an image or chart; use card/layout/horizontal.

placement.statement: inside Card, filling its Layout slot

a11y.fact: a layout frame only: it adds no role of its own, so the card around it decides whether the surface is operable
